result.summary: UAT v9: EO-001 PASS (onboarding wizard complete, slug=swiftroute confirmed on result screen). EO-002 PASS (progress spinner shown). EO-003 PASS (Alice Bauer account in swiftroute Keycloak realm, aud=bpm-platform-api confirmed). EO-004 FAIL MAJOR: Alice cannot reach dashboard — onboarding saga does not provision roles-flattening protocol mapper; SPA OidcCallbackPage receives JWT with realm_access.roles but checks payload.roles (undefined) and enters infinite redirect loop.

issues.description: Alice Bauer cannot access the SwiftRoute workspace through the browser. After successful Keycloak authentication, the SPA enters an infinite redirect loop and never shows the dashboard. Root cause: the onboarding saga provisions the audience protocol mapper but not the User Realm Role mapper that flattens realm_access.roles into a top-level roles claim. The SPA OidcCallbackPage checks payload.roles which is undefined, treats the JWT as invalid, and redirects to login again. Fix: provision a User Realm Role mapper (token_claim_name=roles) alongside the audience mapper during onboarding provisioning.
